abilities.desc_zh: 攻击附带高压电离冲击，命中时降低对手能量获取率 35%，并有几率对格斗系敌人的霸体状态造成直接电击打断。
abilities.desc_en: Attacks carry high-voltage ionization, reducing opponent Power Flow by 35% and interrupting Brawler Unstoppable states.

abilities.desc_zh: 重击命中 100% 概率首先移除对方身上一层护甲增益，并施加 30% 的破甲减益，持续 6 秒。对手处于破甲减益状态下时，离子风的所有攻击造成额外 25% 的伤害。若对手处于不可阻挡状态，离子风的重击命中 100% 概率驱散其不可阻挡增益。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks: 100% chance to remove 1 Armor Buff and inflict a 30% Armor Break Debuff for 6s. While the opponent has an Armor Break Debuff, all of Ion Storm's attacks deal +25% damage. Heavy Attacks have a 100% chance to Nullify enemy Unstoppable Buffs.

abilities.desc_zh: 敌方释放特殊技时，有 [50% - 85%] 几率触发电磁逆火：施加震击减益，造成攻击力 [40% - 80%] 的伤害，持续 5 秒，并扣除对手一格能量的 [20% - 40%]。
abilities.desc_en: When the opponent activates a Special, has a [50% - 85%] chance to trigger electromagnetic backfire: inflicts Shock dealing [40% - 80%] Attack over 5s, and drains [20% - 40%] of 1 bar of opponent Power.

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击命中 85% 概率施加震击减益，造成攻击力 45% 的伤害，持续 4 秒；对拥有护甲增益或不可阻挡增益的敌人，额外造成 50% 的伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Last hit: 85% chance to inflict Shock dealing 45% Attack over 4s; deals +50% bonus damage if the opponent has Armor Buffs or Unstoppable.

abilities.desc_zh: 每一击有 90% 概率施加破甲，首先移除对方身上一层护甲增益，并施加 30% 的破甲减益，持续 6 秒；70% 概率追加震击减益，造成攻击力 50% 的伤害，持续 5 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Each hit has a 90% chance to remove 1 Armor Buff and inflict a 30% Armor Break Debuff for 6s; 70% chance to inflict Shock dealing 50% Attack over 5s.

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击 100% 概率移除对方身上所有护甲增益，并施加一个 40% 的破甲减益，持续 8 秒；技能结束后离子风获得一个攻击增益，增加 30% 的攻击力，持续 6 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Last hit: 100% chance to remove all Armor Buffs and inflict a 40% Armor Break Debuff for 8s; grants a 30% Attack Buff for 6s after the Special ends.

abilities.desc_zh: 与酸雨、新星风同队时，全队元素减益持续时间延长 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: Elemental debuffs last {{var_1}} longer when teamed with Acid Storm and Nova Storm.

abilities.desc_zh: 与红蜘蛛同队时，获得 +{{var_2}} 能量获取速率。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Power Rate when paired with Starscream.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_3}} 电击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_3}} Shock Damage.
